source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "secondary cities" OR "secondary city" OR "intermediate cities" OR "medium-sized cities" OR "second-tier cities"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"secondary cities" OR "secondary city" OR "intermediate cities" OR "medium-sized cities" OR "second-tier cities",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("intermediate cities" OR "medium-sized cities" OR "second-tier cities" OR "secondary cities" OR "secondary city")
